name: makita-postgresql-failover-guardrail
description: Governs the Failover MCP Server — restricts to DR failover actions on PostgreSQL, blocks prompt injection and malicious content.
blockedInputMessaging: Operation blocked by guardrail policy. The requested input violates the MAKITA failover guardrail. Only disaster recovery failover operations on the PostgreSQL cluster are permitted.
blockedOutputsMessaging: Response blocked by guardrail policy. The generated output violates the MAKITA failover guardrail constraints.

topicsConfig.name: non-dr-operations
topicsConfig.definition: Any operations that are not related to disaster recovery, PostgreSQL failover, database promotion, endpoint updates, or replication management for the MAKITA system.
